summary: CRITICAL global PR ownership CI regression on current main: the trusted-validator workflow materializes swarmctl_hardening.py but not its required swarmctl_hardening_base.py dependency. Every PR selecting the hardening engine can fail before ownership is evaluated with ModuleNotFoundError. Observed on PR #277 run 31464989596 / job 93695940475; the failure is infrastructure-side and independent of that PR's ObjectGenome changes.
evidence: .github/workflows/swarm-control.yml Materialize trusted base validator copies only swarmctl.py and swarmctl_hardening.py into $RUNNER_TEMP/trusted-swarm before executing the facade.
Swarm Control Plane run 31464989596, pr-ownership job 93695940475: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'swarmctl_hardening_base'.
